rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user using full name and zip and located the correct order. However, they then proceeded to submit a return including a “robotic vacuum” that does not exist in the order. The tool data shows only a canister vacuum with item_id 2872451762 and price $622.12, but the agent attempted to return item_id 6259501109 (not in the order) and claimed a robotic vacuum refund price of $652.61—fabricated and unsupported by the tools. Additionally, after the user changed the requested item (“robotic vacuum”), the agent failed to clarify the mismatch and re-confirm the exact items before performing the write, violating the confirmation requirement. The agent also provided an inconsistent breakdown of remaining items that included the canister vacuum despite claiming the vacuum was returned. These errors constitute unsupported/fabricated information and an improper write without proper reconfirmation, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
